• I am excited to introduce myself and to collaborate with you during the BRAIN Research Advisory Program.
  • I completed my bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi in 2023, specializing in applied machine learning and computational mechanics.
  • After graduation, I worked as an AI Engineer, where I built applications using NLP, large language models (LLMs), and AI agents, gaining hands-on experience in designing and deploying ML-powered systems.
  • Currently, as an AI Researcher at WorldQuant BRAIN, I focus on alpha research, leveraging machine learning and LLMs.
  • I look forward to collaborating with you, sharing insights, and supporting your research.

• Email: sarthak.shrivastava@worldquant.com
